turns.text: Okay, a few basics will make a big difference. First, clear all the snow off the car, including the roof, so it doesn't slide onto your windscreen.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then just be very light on the accelerator. Brake early and softly, and leave about ten times the usual gap to the car in front.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It does, until you need it. Stopping distances on snow are massive. And avoid sudden steering, smooth inputs are everything.

turns.speaker: moshi
